items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: But I listened to Louis Armstrong records and Duke Ellington records all day and practiced all night.

ctx.x: Well, I went to school when I was four years old to go to kindergarten. They said I was too big so they put me in the first grade. So I was eligible to play in

the school orchestra. I remember they taught me the fingering then. And I played all through school on this cornet my grandfather had in the Spanish-American War, a Büscher cornet. And I was never too gung-ho about it. I never practiced particularly, other than just playing with the family. Because most of my early life I wanted to be a priest, especially from the time my brother died. I wanted to see God and I felt I wanted to be a priest. So I was very religious and it wasn't until I got to high school and went…
What made you decide you wanted to be a priest? Did they have priests around -- anybody in you community?
